# Check: upstream tui-render.test.ts

## Upstream file
tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-render.test.ts

## Subject
TUI rendering, resizing, and shrinkage behavior — including Termux-specific accommodations.

## Upstream test count (approx)
16 (though catalog enumerates ~8 distinct behaviors; re-enumerate when processing)

## Behaviors asserted upstream
- triggers full re-render when terminal height changes
- skips full re-render on height changes in Termux
- does not clear screen on height change in Termux
- does not clear scrollback on height change in Termux
- latest content remains visible after resize in Termux
- triggers full re-render when terminal width changes
- clears empty rows when content shrinks significantly
- handles shrink to single line

## Upstream dependencies
Component, TUI, VirtualTerminal, Terminal from @xterm/headless

## Upstream notes
Termux detected via TERMUX_VERSION env var; skips full re-render on height changes to avoid flicker. setClearOnShrink(true) enables clearing empty rows when content shrinks. fullRedraws counter tracks redraw count. LoggingVirtualTerminal captures writes for debugging.

## Candidate Elixir counterpart(s)
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/tui_render_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/renderer_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/render_throttle_test.exs
- apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/terminal_test.exs

## Processing protocol
Same as standard check ticket protocol in epic opi-q5k description. Compliance ticket must list each missing behavior and require a post-implementation re-comparison. Block opi-q5k.1.

# Audit findings

Upstream: tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/tui-render.test.ts (15 tests across resize / shrinkage / differential-rendering describes)
Ours: apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/tui_render_test.exs (new, untracked — a direct port with ~16 tests + extra streaming-simulation and Interactive-integration tests)

## MAPPED

| # | Upstream | Elixir (tui_render_test.exs) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | triggers full re-render when terminal height changes | "height change triggers full redraw, content preserved" (semantic — no counter assertion) |
| 3 | triggers full re-render when terminal width changes | "width change triggers full redraw" (semantic — no counter assertion) |
| 4 | clears empty rows when content shrinks significantly | "clears stale rows when content shrinks from 6 to 2" |
| 5 | handles shrink to single line | "handles shrink to single line" |
| 6 | handles shrink to empty | "handles shrink to empty" |
| 7 | tracks cursor correctly when content shrinks with unchanged remaining lines | "cursor tracking after shrink with unchanged remaining lines" |
| 8 | renders correctly when only a middle line changes (spinner) | "only middle line changes — spinner animation" |
| 10 | first line changes but rest stays same | "first line changes but rest stays same" |
| 11 | last line changes but rest stays same | "last line changes but rest stays same" |
| 12 | multiple non-adjacent lines change | "non-adjacent line changes preserve unchanged lines between" |
| 13 | transition content → empty → content | "transition: content → empty → content" |
| 16 | clears stale content when maxLinesRendered was inflated by a transient component | "multi-component: chat + editor, stale lines cleared after transient inflation" |

## UNMAPPED

- **#2 "skips full re-render on height changes in Termux"** — our Renderer *does* implement Termux behavior (lib/.../renderer.ex:166 `termux?` + height-only short-circuit) but no test covers it. Verifies: (a) TERMUX_VERSION set → no full redraw on height resize, (b) no `\x1b[2J` or `\x1b[3J` in output, (c) latest content still visible after resize.
- **#9 "resets styles after each rendered line"** — uses `getCellItalic(terminal, 1, 0) === 0`. Requires per-cell SGR introspection in our VT helper (already flagged by opi-q5k.28 for the style-leak ticket; mention cross-reference). Not ported.
- **#14 "full re-renders when deleted lines move the viewport upward"** — our "clears stale rows when content shrinks" is close in shape but does not assert (a) `fullRedraws` counter increment, (b) specific viewport shape `["Line 2"…"Line 6"]` after shrinking 12→7 lines in a 5-row terminal.
- **#15 "appends after a shrink without another full redraw once the viewport is reset"** — our "append after shrink stays clean" verifies content but does not assert that `fullRedraws` stays flat during the append (the differential-path invariant).

Common sub-gap: our Renderer does not expose a `full_redraws` counter. Upstream asserts `tui.fullRedraws > initialRedraws` (and, in #2/#15, `==`). Mapped tests cover the *content* half of the invariant but not the *redraw path* half.

## N/A / EXTRA

Elixir adds streaming-simulation tests and an Interactive.render integration test beyond upstream scope — fine, retained.

## Action

Compliance ticket covering: (a) add a redraw-counter introspection API on Renderer, (b) port Termux test, (c) port SGR-reset test (cross-refs opi-q5k.28 for VT attribute inspection), (d) strengthen shrink/append tests with counter assertions.
